description: List every issuer whose published token list includes an EVM address, one match per chain: Coinbase's tokenized stocks on Base, Robinhood's Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain, Ondo Global Markets and xStocks on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Free. An address on no list gets the look-alike catalogue's answer, and chains_read says which chains' lists were read. For Robinhood Chain identity with look-alikes, use check_address. Same answer as GET https://pegproof.com/v1/lookup/{address}.

address.description: The contract address, 0x followed by 40 hex digits, either case.

name: list_address_issuers
title: List the issuers that list an address
